subject: Overcoming the Epigenetic Reset in Human Stem Cell Models of Neurodegeneration
script: From Agewell Brief: Overcoming the Epigenetic Reset in Human Stem Cell Models of Neurodegeneration. Phase III trials fail because standard models miss complex human genetics and aging. New induced pluripotent stem cell techniques aim to rebuild patient-specific cell biology. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
